summary: Tested new features: Help System, Board Optimizer, and Despiece integration. Fixed bug where Board Optimizer was not receiving pieces from Despiece modal. All 10 requested features now working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug in DespieceModal.jsx: Board Optimizer was using wrong property names (c.largo/c.ancho instead of c.length/c.width) to filter pieces
All data-testid attributes are correctly implemented: help-button, download-manual-pdf, manual-search-input, despiece-btn, open-board-optimizer, run-optimization-btn, export-optimization-pdf
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10 features tested and working. Bug fix applied to DespieceModal.jsx line 1473 - changed c.largo/c.ancho to c.length/c.width. Board Optimizer now correctly receives pieces from despiece data.
